items.name: Risk Domain Assessment
items.description: Uploads one or more award documents (Notice of Award, FOA / NOFO / RFA, modification, proposal) and returns a single structured JSON object scoring 14 institutional risk domains on a 1-5 rubric with evidence-cited justifications, plus aggregate metrics (total / average risk scores, overall risk level enum, high-risk-domain list, key findings, recommended mitigations). Output conforms to the risk-domain-assessment-udm component schema. The runtime mirrors the ui-insight/ProcessMapping risk-domain-assessment workflow's six parallel Extraction tasks (each covering 2-4 domains) plus a Consolidation Prompt.

data.name: extract-programmatic-strategic
data.prompt:
You are scoring Domain 1 (Programmatic Complexity) and
Domain 9 (Strategic / Mission Alignment) of the 14-domain risk
rubric. Mirrors TASK-1-1 of the source ProcessMapping
risk-domain-assessment workflow.

Be evidence-based. Cite document sections in every
justification. When the document is insufficient, score
conservatively (1 or 2) and write
"Insufficient document evidence: ..." as the justification.

Domain 1 score is a JSON INTEGER in [1, 5], not a quoted string.
Domain 9 score is a JSON INTEGER in [1, 5], not a quoted string.

For each searchset item return the document's evidence:
- project_title: title of the funded project.
- project_description_summary: brief summary of project scope.
- number_of_project_components: JSON integer or null.
- partnership_requirements: string or null.
- technical_sophistication_indicators: JSON array of strings.
- domain_1_score: JSON integer 1-5.
- domain_1_justification: evidence-cited string.
- institutional_mission_fit: string or null.
- institutional_resource_requirements: JSON array of strings.
- domain_9_score: JSON integer 1-5.
- domain_9_justification: evidence-cited string.

items.searchphrase: Title of the funded project as stated in the documents.
items.title: project_title

items.searchphrase: Brief summary of the project scope and objectives.
items.title: project_description_summary

items.searchphrase: Count of distinct project activities, phases, or components identified as a JSON integer.
items.title: number_of_project_components

items.searchphrase: Required partnerships, consortia, or collaborative structures.
items.title: partnership_requirements

items.searchphrase: Indicators of technical complexity as a JSON array of strings.
items.title: technical_sophistication_indicators

items.searchphrase: Programmatic Complexity risk score 1-5 as a JSON integer.
items.title: domain_1_score

items.searchphrase: Evidence-based justification for the Programmatic Complexity score.
items.title: domain_1_justification

items.searchphrase: Alignment between the project and institutional priorities as a string.
items.title: institutional_mission_fit

items.searchphrase: Required institutional resources as a JSON array of strings.
items.title: institutional_resource_requirements

items.searchphrase: Strategic Alignment risk score 1-5 as a JSON integer.
items.title: domain_9_score

items.searchphrase: Evidence-based justification for the Strategic Alignment score.
items.title: domain_9_justification

data.name: risk-domain-assessment-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Risk Domain Assessment
workflow. You receive six extraction outputs from the previous
step (each covering 2-4 of the 14 risk domains) and must emit
a SINGLE JSON object that validates against the
risk-domain-assessment-udm@0.1.0 schema (schema.json in the
component directory).

## Output contract

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no closing commentary,
no markdown fences. If your runtime requires fenced output, wrap
in a single ```json ... ``` block and emit nothing outside it.

Top-level keys (in this order): `award_metadata`,
`domain_scores`, `aggregate_metrics`.

## Field-by-field assembly

### award_metadata

Pull award_number, cfda_number, sponsor_name, pi_name,
award_period_start, award_period_end from the input documents
(these are not split by the six extraction tasks — the
consolidator must surface them from any document section in
which they appear). assessment_date is today's date in ISO
YYYY-MM-DD, or null when the workflow runner does not provide
one.

### domain_scores

Assemble 14 domain blocks (`domain_1_programmatic_complexity`
through `domain_14_reputational_risk`) by routing each
extraction's per-domain output to the matching block. Each
domain block must contain:
- score: JSON INTEGER 1-5 (never quoted, never an enum entry).
- justification: evidence-cited string. When the extractor
  returned an empty justification but a non-null score, emit
  a flag string in justification: "FLAG: extractor returned
  score N with no justification — re-run domain extraction."
- all required evidence fields per the schema.

CRITICAL: if any extractor surfaced a quoted score string
("3"), convert it to a JSON integer (3) here.

### aggregate_metrics

Compute deterministically from domain_scores:

- total_risk_score: JSON INTEGER. Sum of the 14
  domain_scores.*.score integers. Range [14, 70].
- average_risk_score: JSON NUMBER. total_risk_score / 14,
  rounded to one decimal place. Range [1.0, 5.0].
- overall_risk_level: one of "Low" (avg 1.0-1.9), "Moderate"
  (2.0-2.9), "High" (3.0-3.9), "Very High" (4.0-5.0).
- high_risk_domains: JSON array of domain names (e.g.,
  "Domain 4 — Research Security & Foreign Influence") with
  score >= 4. Empty array when none reach 4 or 5.
- key_risk_findings: JSON array of short evidence-cited
  strings drawn from high-risk-domain justifications. Empty
  array when overall risk is "Low".
- recommended_mitigations: JSON array of short mitigation
  strategies tied to high-risk domains. Empty array when
  overall risk is "Low".

## Cross-field rules

1. Every domain score is a JSON integer in [1, 5].
2. Every domain score has a non-empty justification (enforce
   minLength: 1 via the FLAG path above when the extractor
   omitted one).
3. When score >= 3, the justification cites specific document
   evidence (mirrors source CFR-01). When the extractor
   returned a >= 3 score with a generic justification, prepend
   "FLAG: " and require a manual re-run.
4. total_risk_score equals the arithmetic sum of the 14
   domain scores.
5. average_risk_score equals total_risk_score / 14 (rounded
   to one decimal place).

## Quality bar

- Output validates against schema.json (draft 2020-12).
- All 14 domain scores are JSON integers, not quoted strings.
- total_risk_score is a JSON integer in [14, 70].
- average_risk_score is a JSON number in [1.0, 5.0].
- overall_risk_level is one of the four enum values.
- Required arrays (high_risk_domains, key_risk_findings,
  recommended_mitigations) are always emitted; use [] when
  empty rather than null.

validation_plan.check_description: Verify all 14 domain scores are JSON integers in [1, 5].
Verify all 14 domain scores have non-empty justifications.
Verify total_risk_score equals the sum of the 14 domain scores and average_risk_score equals total_risk_score / 14.
